description: Unattended overnight runs: while the user sleeps or is away for hours, the agent works through a written to-do list on its own — self-paced /loop wake-ups, one item at a time, sub-agents for the legwork, evidence and a commit for every 'done', the most conservative default for anything it would have to ask about, and a five-part report in the morning. 夜间无人值班：用户睡觉或离开几个小时，让 agent 按一份待办清单自己推进——/loop 自定节奏、一次一项、子代理分工、每项有证据和提交、要拍板的事先用最保守的默认值、早上交五段式报告。用户说「我要睡了 / 出门几小时，你自己接着做」「挂一晚上」「夜间值班」时使用。
